newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Manuel says no plans to leave finance.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Manuel says no plans to leave finance.

text.p: South African Finance Minister Trevor Manuel has dismissed speculation that his job is to be given to someone else in a cabinet reshuffle.
"Both President (Nelson) Mandela and Deputy President (Thabo) Mbeki called to say there are no plans to move me," Manuel said in an interview with Johannesburg's Business Times published on Sunday.
They were the first comments from Manuel since rumours of a possible reshuffle began earlier this month.

Local newspapers reported at the time that several cabinet ministers were due to retire, leading to a reshuffle in which Manuel would be moved to the foreign ministry and be replaced in the finance portfolio by Trade and Industry Minister Alec Erwin.
But government officials firmly rejected the speculation about imminent plans for replacing the finance minister.
